title: Japan tour and the funeral music
summary: The Japan stay of three months, and an interpreter explaining the funeral music to the audience.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Oh. Now you take another place where the people went wild over the music, over in Japan. Did you go to Japan?
I stayed in Japan three months.
You went there with the teeth.

You went there with the teeth. Yeah. Three months we stayed in Japan. And the people were so amazed about the music, though. I mean, especially when we played, of course, the walk with the, I mean, the Japanese cry. It was so sad. You see, we had an interpreter there where he used to tell them what the way, what that music means and what we play that music for, you know? And after we'd play that, then we'd pick it up and, you know, then he'd tell them that's the way to do when we'd bring a bar that's to the graveyard. Yeah.
